scope: Historical implementation and evidence compatibility for the P2 ten-machine causal comparison contract; no locked performance data were read.

findings.compatibility: Ten-machine and causal, but its parameters and metrics must be regenerated under the new P2 role and evaluation contract.
The report describes an accepted clustered-model result but does not bind a current immutable run; old numerical parameters and headline metrics are ineligible for the P2 main table.
The registered historical configuration uses clustered_7 and no matching immutable result directory was found. The ten-machine causal closure must be fitted from scratch.
The ten-machine v6 result is a conditional rollout with observed Pm. It cannot serve as a causal ZOH baseline and must be refitted and replayed.
The run uses clustered_7, five folds, three seeds, short registered horizons and already-opened test data. Its performance values cannot enter P2 selection or the causal main table.

role_audit.finding: The near-critical source cannot support the preregistered source-level fault-line bootstrap with only two internal lines.
role_audit.decision: P2 will deterministically repartition only F1 training fault lines, stratified by source and without reading trajectories or labels, to reserve at least three internal lines per source.

claim_boundary: Historical artifacts establish method availability and incompatibility facts only; they do not establish P2 comparative performance.
